sql: SELECT T1.school_district FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code WHERE T2.State = 'Wisconsin' ORDER BY T1.t_fed_rev DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.c14) FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code WHERE T2.State = 'Virginia'

SELECT T2.State, T3.average_scale_score, SUM(T1.c14), SUM(T1.c25) FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY T3.average_scale_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM (SELECT T1.school_district, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state ORDER BY T1.c14 DESC LIMIT 1) UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT T1.school_district, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state ORDER BY T1.c25 DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT state FROM NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 ORDER BY average_scale_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.school_district FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state ORDER BY CAST(T1.t_fed_rev AS REAL) / T3.average_scale_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.State, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY SUM(T1.t_fed_rev) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.school_district FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state ORDER BY CAST(T1.t_fed_rev AS REAL) / T3.average_scale_score ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.State, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State = T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY SUM(T1.t_fed_rev) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT state FROM NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 ORDER BY average_scale_score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT average_scale_score FROM NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 WHERE state = 'California'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.school_district) FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code WHERE T2.State = 'Indiana'
SELECT State_Code FROM FINREV_FED_KEY_17 WHERE State = 'Virginia'
SELECT T2.State FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY SUM(T1.t_fed_rev) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(T1.c14), SUM(T1.c25) FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code = T2.State_Code WHERE T2.State = 'Colorado'
